run.brief: Create one valid schema_version 1 portfolio with run id run-15-performance-brand-architecture, atlas_version 1, ISO UTC generated_at, method and generator name "performance brand architecture stress test", generator kind agent/provider openai/model gpt-5.6-terra/reasoning_effort xhigh/agent_id null. Put this full brief verbatim in run.brief. intended_territories: music-notation-performance, theater-choreography, craft-material, architecture-construction, writing-editing-publishing. intended_strategies: proper-mythic-historical, institutional-community, phrase-imperative, abstract-sound-brand, ordinary-object. intended_audiences: buyers-founders, educators-writers, oss-contributors, international-users, elixir-maintainers. Generate exactly 100 candidate observations with contiguous ordinals 1..100 and exactly 20 wildcard true. Do not rank, filter, deduplicate, browse, availability-check, or suppress odd/bad/colliding candidates. Use only valid atlas IDs. Explore the full brand-architecture surface, not just package nouns: master brands, descriptive categories, project/community/institute/foundation/studio/workshop forms, product-family roots, research-paper names, conference speech, and names that can or cannot support an Elixir implementation identity. Heavily sample proper, mythic, historical, institutional, and community forms because those lexical strategies are underrepresented, but also include anti-canon, obscure, over-grand, bureaucratic, culturally borrowed, playful, and structurally awkward counterforms. Explicitly document authority, governance, appropriation, canon, hero-worship, non-profit/institute implication, trademark, pronunciation, and product-boundary concerns. Respect the product boundary: a pre-release Elixir/OTP library for declared, callable, measurable, improvable LM programs, with a credible typed textual/artifact optimization horizon; not an official DSPy port, static proof system, universal agent OS, provider SDK, or guaranteed autonomous self-improvement engine. Every observation needs substantive rationale, honest etymology when applicable, semantic territories and lexical strategies, architecture lenses, audiences, and concerns. Validate with jq and report only after the file is complete.

candidates.grammar: Master brand; Daedalus.Program could name an Elixir root.
candidates.rationale: A mythic maker and builder frames declared programs as designed artifacts whose executions vary within an explicit construction.
candidates.etymology: Proper name from Greek myth, conventionally attached to an ingenious craftsman and architect.
known_concerns: Centers a lone heroic inventor and can imply individual authority over collaborative maintenance.
Greek myth imports a Western canon and has pronunciation, trademark, and existing-name collision risk.
Its ingenuity story must not imply autonomous self-improvement or a universal agent system.

candidates.grammar: Master-brand variant; usable as Vitruvia.Program but not a descriptive package name.

candidates.etymology: Coined feminine-form derivative of Vitruvius, the Roman author associated with architectural theory.
known_concerns: Derivation may read as hero worship of a canonical Roman authority and as a superficial gendered alteration.
The Latinate form is not instantly pronounceable internationally and needs trademark research.
Architectural metaphor risks suggesting static, formally proven structures rather than revisable LM programs.

candidates.grammar: Research program or conference series; awkward as an Elixir namespace because of the space.

known_concerns: Latin prestige can reproduce academic gatekeeping and a narrow canon.
